name: bedrock-migration-assessment
cost: Apache 2.0 licence. Cost not stated in the README
works_with: Claude Code through the aws-startup-advisor plugin. Other agents through `npx skills add`
short: Finds every OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or OpenRouter call in your code and starts the questions for moving them to Amazon Bedrock.
what: bedrock-migration-assessment is a skill in AWS's aws-startup-advisor plugin. It scans your code for calls to OpenAI (direct or Azure), Anthropic, Google Gemini and OpenRouter, or validates an `ai-workload-profile.json` you already have, and writes a short preview. With your consent and an admin or management key it can also measure your OpenAI, Anthropic and OpenRouter usage, read only. Then it asks the migration questions and saves your answers to `preferences.json`.
who: Teams thinking about moving their model calls to Amazon Bedrock who want a map of what they use first. This release stops after the questions: it does not design, estimate or rewrite code. The skill points to llm-to-bedrock for rewriting SDK calls.
needs: A coding agent. Plugins exist for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Devin
An AWS account with credentials configured locally for API calls and script execution
uv, for the AWS MCP Server setup on agents without a plugin
An admin or management key from OpenAI, Anthropic or OpenRouter only if you want usage measured

steps.title: Install the plugin in Claude Code
steps.text: aws-startup-advisor comes from this repository's own marketplace.

steps.title: Or install the skills for another agent
Ask for an assessment
steps.text: Open your agent in the project and ask which AI provider calls your code makes and what moving them to Bedrock involves. The skill writes its files to `.migration/bma-[MMDD-HHMM]/` in your project.

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.text: Find which OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or OpenRouter calls this code makes and assess a migration to Amazon Bedrock.

watch: Measuring usage needs an admin or management key from the provider. It is optional and only runs with your consent.
The skill says it never opens `.env` files, private keys or other secret files in your project.
It stops after the questions and does not produce a design, cost estimate or code changes yet.
The plugin also bundles the AWS MCP Server, which can call AWS APIs with your credentials.
